hints.title: Floating Point Average
hints.text: Compute the sum of elements divided by the array length.

hints.title: Lower Candidate Boundary
hints.text: Initialize the candidate to the smallest positive integer strictly larger than the computed average.

hints.title: Presence Verification
hints.text: Increment the candidate until finding a value not present in the original set.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def smallestAbsentPositive(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
        seen = set(nums)
        # Find smallest positive integer strictly greater than average not in nums
        cand = max(1, int(avg) + 1)
        if cand <= avg:
            cand += 1
            
        while cand in seen:
            cand += 1
            
        return cand
```

complexity.notes: Hash set lookup for successive integers starting above average.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the array repeatedly for each integer takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores elements in a hash set of size N for O(1) membership checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge cases where average is negative or non-integer.
